text:
maya: quick ask — i'm about to merge a terraform change that adds an eks iam annotation to telemetry service account in telemetry namespace. want a quick sanity check on rollout behavior: will existing pods pick this up or do we need to restart deployments?
chris: can you paste the PR/manifest? that helps. quick note: annotation looks like the usual `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`.
maya: PR — https://git.redwood/infra/telemetry/+/2345 (file: k8s/telemetry-sa.tf) — terraform uses `kubernetes_manifest` to patch the SA with:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: telemetry-sa
  namespace: telemetry
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-telemetry
```
chris: ok. small explainer: IRSA is resolved at the time the pod exchanges the projected service account token with STS. changing the SA annotation doesn't forcibly cycle pods. pods that call STS with the old token might keep using the previous assumed role until token rotation happens or the pod restarts.
devon: +1. kubelet rotates projected serviceaccount tokens on a TTL (default ~1h) but rollout/restart is the quickest deterministic way to ensure new tokens and role mapping. if you need zero-downtime, do a canary restart.
sre-jen: also watch for cached credentials in apps (aws sdk caches creds). even if the token rotates, app might keep old creds until it refreshes. recommend restarting the pods for the first rollout and monitor auth errors.
maya: got it. does `kubernetes_manifest`/terraform plan indicate any change to pods? plan shows only `serviceaccount.telemetry-sa` will be updated (annotation changed).
chris: terraform will only update the SA object. k8s won't evict pods for an SA annotation change. so you will have to trigger restarts if you want immediate effect.
devon: if you want a controlled flow, do: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/telemetry -n telemetry` and then watch pods come up with new projected token. you can verify by exec into pod and checking `/var/run/secrets/eks.amazonaws.com/serviceaccount/token` age or call the metadata endpoint.
maya: nice — any objections to doing a canary (1 pod) restart first?
sre-jen: no objections. also suggest adding this note to the PR description: "service account annotation update; will restart pods in telemetry deployment as a canary step to ensure role pick-up". saves followups from SRE.
acho-bot: deploy-bot: k8s api: serviceaccount/telemetry-sa updated by terraform at 2026-03-17T17:03:12Z
chris: one extra gotcha — if you have projected token audience or bound token settings changed elsewhere (eg. `TokenRequest` TTLs), double-check they align. but for simple IRSA role-arn swaps, restart is fine.
maya: thanks all — i'll add the restart step to the PR and do canary then full rollout. will post results here. :thumbsup:
